intro: Premium Launch Edition includes full game, bonus currency and select vehicles. Race licensed cars on real tracks with realistic physics. Tune your car and compete.
description:
Premium Launch Edition includes the full game, bonus currency, and curated vehicles to start your racing journey.

AUTHENTIC RACING EXPERIENCE
Experience realistic physics and handling with authentic licensed vehicles and real-world tracks. Master technical circuits where precision and skill determine victory.

LICENSED VEHICLES & TRACKS
Race genuine licensed cars with accurate performance characteristics. Challenge yourself on faithfully recreated tracks that demand perfect racing lines and expert car control.

DEEP CUSTOMIZATION
Fine-tune suspension, differential, tire pressure, and gear ratios to match your driving style. Every adjustment affects handling and performance on track.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Compete against players worldwide in real-time races. Test your skills in time attack leaderboards and ranked events.

PREMIUM LAUNCH EDITION CONTENTS
- Full game access
- Bonus currency for vehicle purchases
- Curated vehicle selection to begin racing immediately

Master the art of racing simulation where physics, precision, and skill matter most.
